description: This file defines the PdfStandardSecurityHandler class, a core component in the PDFsharp library for managing standard PDF security (encryption and permissions), including encryption setup, crypt filter management, password validation, and object encryption/decryption.

classes.name: PdfStandardSecurityHandler
classes.description: Represents the standard PDF security handler capable of setting encryption, managing crypt filters, validating passwords, and encrypting/decrypting PDF objects.

methods.name: EnsureEncryptionIsSet
methods.description: Ensures that the encryption object is initialized; if not, sets the default encryption.

methods.name: SetDefaultEncryption
methods.description: Initializes encryption with the most recent encryption method not requiring PDF 2.0.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToNoneAndResetPasswords
methods.description: Configures the handler to not encrypt the PDF and resets user and owner passwords.

methods.name: SetEncryption
methods.description: Sets the encryption algorithm based on the specified PdfDefaultEncryption enum value.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToV1
methods.description: Configures encryption for Version 1 (RC4 with 40-bit key).

methods.name: SetEncryptionToV2
methods.description: Configures encryption for Version 2 (RC4 with specified key length, PDF 1.4).

methods.name: SetEncryptionToV2With128Bits
methods.description: Configures encryption for Version 2 with 128-bit key (default in older PDFsharp versions).

methods.name: SetEncryptionToV4UsingRC4
methods.description: Configures encryption for Version 4 using RC4 algorithm.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToV4UsingAES
methods.description: Configures encryption for Version 4 using AES algorithm.

methods.name: GetIfEncryptionIsActive
methods.description: Returns this security handler if encryption is active; otherwise, null.

methods.name: UserPassword
methods.description: Get/set user password for the document; ensures encryption is set when changed.

methods.name: OwnerPassword
methods.description: Get/set owner password for the document; ensures encryption is set when changed.

methods.name: Permissions
methods.description: Get/set document permissions as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: ValidatePassword
methods.description: Validates input password against the encryption, updates permissions accordingly.

methods.name: EncryptStream
methods.description: Encrypts a PDF stream, using crypt filters if supported.

methods.name: DecryptStream
methods.description: Decrypts a PDF stream, using crypt filters if supported.
